title: fynkel.Emitter
description: Instantiates `prefab` at the entity's world pose `rate` times per second (pre-tick slot; the fractional remainder carries over so 2.5/s alternates 2 and 3 per second): each instance is the prefab's root, unparented and named after the prefab, with the prefab's other entities under it — exactly `World::instantiate` — with a `LifetimeDespawn { seconds: lifetime }` on the root when `lifetime > 0`, and every dynamic `RigidBody` in it starts at `velocity` (world axes). With `max_alive > 0` no more are spawned while that many of this emitter's instances live. The world must know the prefab (`World::register_prefab`; the loaders register every prefab a loaded scene's emitters name, `PREFAB_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

lifetime.description: Seconds each instance lives, `>= 0`; `0` keeps them.

max_alive.description: Ceiling on this emitter's live instances; `0` is unlimited.

velocity.description: Initial linear velocity of each instance's dynamic bodies, m/s.
